name: n4_station_runtime
description: What the station is running, in one read (read-only): uptime, from the spy page sysInfo: boot_time, current_time and up_time as the station writes them (localized text) and uptime_s, the seconds between its bootTicks and currentTicks; loaded_modules, from the spy page sysManagers/moduleManager, which lists only the module parts the station has loaded: count and modules (name, vendor, version), up to max_rows, truncated when cut; jars_on_disk: the session lists no module jars, so its status is unavailable (note says why) unless the server was started with --niagara-home NAME=PATH for this station (its Niagara installation directory, reachable from this machine): then the .jar files of PATH/modules (modules_dir, count; a link or other non-regular file is never opened and is named in skipped), with the root attributes of META-INF/module.xml read only from the jars that may hold a loaded part and from those changed after the boot (versions_read; jars whose module.xml cannot be read are named in unreadable; complete is false then or when the scan stopped at 5000 jars or timeout_s). mismatches (up to max_rows, mismatch_count, mismatches_truncated; null without the jars): module, reason, loaded_version, disk_version, jar and jar_modified, where reason is version_differs (the jar holds another version than the loaded one), modified_after_boot (same version, but the jar changed after the boot), loaded_not_on_disk (no jar holds the loaded part) or not_loaded_modified_after_boot (a jar of no loaded part changed after the boot). The boot is this machine's clock minus uptime_s, compared with the jar times of this machine's filesystem, with 2 s of slack. restart_needed is true with any mismatch, false only when the uptime, the whole loaded list and every jar are known and none differs, and null otherwise; restart_note says which. A spy page the user may not read is that section's status (forbidden, not_found, not_html, parse_timeout, with a hint), never a failed call; a page without the measured layout is not_recognized with a hint.

max_rows.description: Cap of the loaded modules and of the mismatches listed, each

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout per request in seconds; also bounds the reading of the jars
